title: add-rbac-witness-service-and-kms-region-assertor
author: Anita Shah
description: Problem: customers in regulated industries require non-repudiable RBAC decisions and strict region pinning for KMS usage. Existing RBAC v2 checks are stateless and do not provide a signed decision artifact for downstream auditors. KMS region enforcement currently relies on best-effort annotations and can be bypassed by operator tooling in edge cases. Motivation: introduce a small, high-trust 'witness' service that signs RBAC decisions (decision digest + policy fingerprint + request metadata) to create verifiable audit artifacts and add a per-request KMS Region Assertor that validates KMS key location claims and rejects requests that do not satisfy tenant region constraints. Scope: 1) service/rbac/witness: new internal HTTP gRPC stub and signer using customer-configured KMS keys; 2) pkg/kms/region_assertor.go: validation logic + cache with TTL and soft-fail toggle; 3) policy/compiler: attach policy fingerprint to decision events; 4) rwctl CLI: operator commands to rotate witness key and inspect witness ledger; 5) docs: compliance guide and migration notes. This PR is intentionally self-contained: the witness is opt-in via feature flag "rbac.witness.enabled" and default behavior is unchanged. Risk: signing keys are managed via KMS — we added safeguards (caller identity checks, scope-limited IAM role, and audit-only dry-run mode) and added integration tests in the CI matrix. See linked linear items ENG-2055 and ENG-2099 for compliance requirements and rollout plan.
